sloka: इत्युक्त्वा न्यपतद् भ्रातु: पादयोर्भरतस्तदा ।भृशं सम्प्रार्थयामास राममेव प्रियंवद: ॥ २.११२.१४॥
transliteration: ityuktvā nyapatad bhrātu: pādayorbharatastadā ।bhṛśaṁ samprārthayāmāsa rāmameva priyaṁvada: ॥ 2.112.14॥

translations.english: Having said this, Bharata, fell at the feet of his brother, and speaking sweetly, he profusely entreated Rama.
